why: The main conjunct corollary_15_3_10_3_regular assumes, besides B's hypotheses, the tame-germ hypothesis A.B.IsScFredholmSectionTame f and sc-smooth partitions of unity on the object M-polyfold (corollary_15_3_10_3_collar: pointwise bump functions instead), which B does not have. With both added, A => Bcore (regular perturbation of f̃ = cubeLiftSec f, Λ̃ = Λⁱ over {i} x X, Λ̃∘f̃ branched and compact) passes #rt_check; B's further conclusions (Θ̃ tame, ∂Θ̃(i,x) = Θᵢ(x)) are not stated in the main conjunct and follow only with project cylinder lemmas that route through the item's own theorems (main_to_Bplus, not rt-clean).
